title: bupleurum falcatum subsp. cernuum
intro: Bupleurum falcatum subsp. cernuum, commonly known as Cernua Bupleurum or Chinese Thorowax, is a plant species in the genus Bupleurum. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fever, as well as treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cernua Bupleurum include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of Cernua Bupleurum, such as saikosaponins and sesquiterpenes, are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat a range of health conditions.
